Prompt Bricks Library

Compose assistant-agnostic prompts from five ordered layers: role and persona, base instructions, context format, task specification, and output format. Preview each brick before adding it; only its prompt template is added to the combined prompt.

Build a combined prompt

Preview a brick to inspect the exact text that will be included, then add only the layers and bricks that apply. The combined prompt is ordered by layer; review and fill in each brick's {{placeholder}} values before sending it to your assistant.
